test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The Songi Mukhawate dance of ___________ celebrates the victory of truth over falsehood. The name of the dance is derived from the two lion masks worn by two dancers who represent Narasimha, an aspect of Lord Vishnu.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Songi Mukhawate** dance of **Maharashtra** celebrates the **victory of truth over falsehood.**
 
• The name of the dance is derived from the two lion masks worn by** two dancers who represent Narasimha, an aspect of Lord Vishnu.**
 
• **Songi Mukhawate** is a traditional folk dance performed during v**arious festivals and cultural events in Maharashtra.**
 
• **The dance highlights **the themes of **righteousness and the triumph of good over evil, symbolized by the depiction of Narasimha.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Tertali (Madhya Pradesh):**

 
 
• **​**A ritualistic dance performed by the **Kamar tribe, **often involving **women who sit on the ground with small cymbals tied to different parts of their body.**
 
 
 
• **Chhau (Jharkhand):**
 
 
• **​**A semi-classical Indian dance with **martial, tribal, and folk traditions,** often depicting e**pisodes from epics like the Ramayana and Mahabharata.**
 
 
 
• **Garba (Gujarat):**
 
 
• **​**A popular folk dance performed during the** Navratri festival, **characterized by **rhythmic clapping and circular movements.**
